title: How to Build Smooth Scrolling Animations With Claude Code and Kling
description: How to Build Smooth Scrolling Animations With Claude Code and Kling
transcript: If you use Claude code to build websites, you can create these animations easily. Let me show you how. First, generate your start and end frame. Here, we have a keyboard in a normal state, and then we can deconstruct it with an x-ray version. Next, throw the two frames in Kling, and then tell it to create a smooth transition between them. Then, drop the MP4 into Claude with a specific prompt. The prompt tells Claude code how to extract the frames and convert them to WebP, so you can create this buttery smooth animation. It works incredibly well. If you want the exact prompt, check the description or head over to our community. The link is in the bio.
